name: Hitozuma Mahjong
source:
Main character participates in multiple mahjong tournaments to get money from men and get intimate with women. He's only interested in married women.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角參加各種麻將比賽，既從男人手中贏錢，也藉機親近女人。他只對已婚女人感興趣。
